about: Lean set actually run for the 2026-10-25 baseline under the owner's spending cap: 20 items (16 tuning, 4 held-back). The runner stopped at the scorecard's cost share after two empty answers cost about USD 0.4 each (whole Labour Code injected, lookup loop). Held-back court cases were not reached, so the held-back outcome target cannot be measured on this set; court outcome is reported on the 3 tuning cases as counts only. The final run must use this same set. 'planned_30' is the intended lean set for a later run within budget.
